capabilities: Anchor review comments to paragraphs, headings, list items, images, code blocks, callouts, or tables
Pin comments to native ^blockref markers so they survive document reflow
Manage open, resolved, overdue, and stale comments in a per-document review sidebar
List every .review.md in the vault in a cross-doc dashboard with open, stale, and overdue counts
Reattach stale comments using saved anchor context after the anchor block is edited away
extras: The .review.md sidecar is a documented markdown format intended to be readable by any downstream tool, including scripts and AI assistants; the plugin is deliberately not bound to any specific consumer.
intentEvidence: it has no built-in equivalent to a GitHub pull-request review. This plugin adds that workflow
motivation: The author wanted a review workflow for long documents written collaboratively 'with yourself, your future self, or external tools', where a downstream tool or human can act on the comments.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in equivalent to a GitHub pull-request review for marking up a document with change-request comments.
summary: Review-comment system that adds PR-style comments anchored to blocks, stored in a .review.md sidecar so the source document stays clean.
